content: Tang et al. BIBREF14 provided straightforward algorithm for term matching. The algorithm starts with finding candidate terms that contain ALL the entity words, with term frequency - inverse document frequency (tf-idf) weighting. Then the candidates are ranked based on the pairwise cosine distance between the word embeddings of the candidates and the entity.
